design.constraint_geometry: Separate spectral-norm balls and nonnegative factors.
design.full_batch: SFRAMES with all training views and separately tuned gamma0. The decay exponents and smoothing scale are shared.
design.inference: Fresh slices from separated acquisition batches of two sample mixes. Slices in a mix share a sample tube; summarize paired effects descriptively.
design.selection: No evaluation slice, held-out view, or reference image enters rate selection.
design.diagnostics: Evaluation records initialization and every native completed optimizer update, including continued prefixes.
design.grouping: Median over seeds within slice, then slices within specimen group, then across groups.
design.palm_repetitions: All three seeds executed with independent fresh power directions; 84 physical runs.

comparison.direction: Minibatch SFRAMES minus comparator. Negative favors SFRAMES.
comparison.pairing: Same slice and training-view count with shared calibration; stochastic arms pair by oracle seed. Each deterministic arm runs once per slice/size and is shared across paired seed cases.
comparison.within_budget: Last recorded iterate at or below the cap, without interpolation.
comparison.endpoint: Last observation, possibly after overshooting the nominal work cap.
comparison.summary_estimate: Median over paired seeds within slices, then slices within specimen groups, then over specimen groups. Groups have equal weight.
comparison.percentages: Paired comparator value is the denominator; zero denominators excluded.
comparison.scope: Specimen-group summaries are descriptive; slices and oracle seeds are not independent specimens.
comparison.source_provenance: Each run retains actual source hashes; partial-checkpoint recovery and continuations retain exact validated native prefixes and original metadata. The only compatible numerical revisions are the audited one-line zero-projection division guard. Source checkpoint/trace/metadata hashes are retained. Pairing requires identical instance data, calibration, initialization, constraints and audited-compatible numerical sources.

targets.definition: First saved native iterate within69120viewsperside satisfying both repaired_loss / initial_repaired_loss <= relative_repaired_loss and raw d_D / initial_factor_frobenius_norm <= max_relative_d_distance. No interpolated crossing; unreached cases remain censored.
targets.provenance: Thresholds fixed before expanded evaluation. Initial factor norms on two original development slices are2.919423056505318 and2.8323907551932765. Feasibility levels span1% and0.1% of this factor scale; loss levels40% and30% of initial repaired training loss.
targets.report_rule: Report attainment and censoring for all four prespecified targets, not only successful targets. Paired work ratios only on common attained cases, with denominator coverage explicit. Aggregate seed then slice then specimen group.

historical_selection.rule: Smallest median repaired-to-initial training-loss ratio, taking medians over the three development oracle seeds within each slice/training-size case, then over the two original development slices and both training-view counts at the last within-budget iterate. PALM is deterministic and runs once per case. Candidates with nonfinite arithmetic are excluded; operational/projection failures halt selection. Ties favor smaller step multiplier, then smaller secondary parameter.
